Name: PFM Pottery Kiln for 1.6
Author: Syanide23
Description:
Updates [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sylvarmyst?gameId=1303]sylvarmyst[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4362]original pottery kiln[/url] mod for 1.6 with permission from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sylvarmyst?gameId=1303]sylvarmyst[/url].

The items needing to be sold to obtain perfection can now be toggled off.

Now supports several mods such as:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21038]Rocks and Relics (formerly The Geology Mod 1.6)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword and Sorcery[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]

Creates unique ceramics by putting minerals and certain resources into the kiln. Original description from original mod:

"Adds a new functional machine to the game that can be used to produce 61 unique ceramic pots ! Each pot is made using clay and another material
which will determine the glaze color of the pottery produced.
Materials that can be used as glaze for pottery kiln include:
 [list]
[*]All metal ores
[*]All [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]foraged minerals[/url]﻿
[*]All [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]gems[/url]﻿
[*]All [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]geode minerals[/url]﻿
[*]Rainbow shells
[*]Solar essence
[*]Void essence
[*]Clay itself (makes a very simple pot)
[/list]
The kiln is a recolor of the charcoal kiln and can be purchased from Clint for 5000 gold. The kiln uses 5 clay as a starter.

The time required to produce each pot is determined by its monetary value.
Cheaper pots will take one hour to produce. Mid-range pots will take two
hours. The most valuable pots will take 5 hours, except for the
Prismatic Pot, which takes 10 hours."

Also adds a few new pots:

Uranium Vase, radioactive ore
Black Ceramic Pot, coal
Three Ceramic Pots, cinder shard
Bone Pot, bone fragment
Mossy Pot, moss
Repaired Amphora, chipped amphora
Nautilus Shell Pot, nautilus shell
Clam Pot, clam shell
Dwarven Pot, dwarvish helm
Coral Pot, coral
Mosaic Pot, glass shards
